title: Static or predictable IV/nonce
message: The IV or nonce is static or predictably generated.
remediation: Generate a fresh IV or nonce with a CSPRNG for every encryption.

evidence.code: wechatpy/crypto/base.py:28 iv or key[:16]; IV omitted or None at wechatpy/crypto/base.py:39 WeChatCipher(key)

wechatpy/crypto/base.py:29 Cipher(algorithms.AES(key), modes.CBC(iv)) -> wechatpy/crypto/base.py:15 self.cipher = cipher -> wechatpy/crypto/base.py:18 tmp0.encryptor() -> wechatpy/crypto/base.py:19 encryptor.update(plaintext) -> wechatpy/crypto/base.py:56 tmp5.encrypt(text)

title: ECB mode used
remediation: Use an authenticated mode such as GCM.
